prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-67849 Payment Details
prose.body:
Hi Driftmoor Retail team,

Hope your week is going well! Just sending a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-67849 for the recent logistics services, totaling 6246.87 USDC.

We noticed this hasn't cleared yet. To make things easy, please direct the payment to our standard receiving wallet: 0x08b3f9b35995b9d36d980ef717dad192a039b42e. This is the same address we’ve used for your previous transactions, so you can safely add it to your contacts.

If you have any questions or need an updated invoice copy, just hit reply. We appreciate your prompt attention to this.

Best regards,
Accounts Receivable
Elmstead Logistics
